pattern: 他動詞 & 自動詞（たどうし & じどうし）
aliases: たどうし & じどうし
purpose: Distinguish an affected object from a change in the thing itself.
keywords: Transitive: object + を + verb; intransitive: subject + が + verb.
The window opened in the wind.
When I turned off the light, the room became dark.
formation: Transitive: object + を + verb; intransitive: subject + が + verb.
restrictions: Many verb pairs are lexical and must be learned individually.
mistake: Do not create a transitive verb by freely changing a vowel.
